finding.title: The code uses cin to read values into vectors without checking if the input size exceeds the allocated memory.
The code does not handle potential integer overflow when performing arithmetic operations.
The code uses abs(v[i] - h) without ensuring that v[i] and h are within a valid range for the abs function.
The code uses magic numbers like 1000000007 without defining them as constants with meaningful names.
